They eat the meat, then wear what remains, never wondering what happens когда nothing is left to eat. Тратит now. Wear now. The Rouges worship depletion. They do not walk toward depletion because they love hide. They came to wear hide because depletion was always its destination.

The Golden Hide, затем, could be described as a hide whose very structure is densely packed with minute bundles of gold. The Hide that один раз filled the cracks truly had been someone's skin и flesh. And один раз it was tanned, it came для получения on arboreal properties befitting the Golden Bough.

But was the Golden Bough ever truly established to be a plant?

Before the department store was built, a being of eld survived as если на miracle и left behind an offspring. That surviving descendant was beached on the Shore, there to become material for a new age.

The Sisyphe System has changed its form time и again with each passing age. Grand Magasin Sisyphe is simply the form one of its Giants—namely the Architect, who was also an Alterationist—deemed the most convenient и suitable for realization within the Symbolic.

In the Symbolic, upon landing <color=#F8C200>Attack Chain 2</color>, наносит <color=#F8C200>Mark of the King of Needleworks</color>
- Inflicts this effect only когда there are no targets that have this <color=#F8C200>Mark</color>
- Mark of the King of Needleworks duration: 5 seconds
- Affected target Movement Speed -30%
- Когда the affected target is killed, deals 3 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> within 3 tiles (0.1 seconds Hitstun)
- After the effect duration исчезает, removes the Mark и deals 5 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color>
- Если that Damage kills the affected target, deals 3 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> within 1 tile (0.1 seconds Hitstun)
dataList.description:
Thread и needle. B2F was built from the need for these two concepts.

Thread seeks to penetrate the needle, Пока needle longs to be penetrated. To handle the essence, one must draw close to the essence oneself; therefore, the deeper one descends to the basement, the clarity of existence blurs и segments until it is reduced to a collection of bits.
Though the concept of thread и needle does, indeed, approach the essence of clothing closely, it is not the same as the essence. The dissolving of the Alterationist, who handles thread, is an inevitable fate.

dataList.statText: After <color=#F8C200>Blocking</color> in the Symbolic, <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> Dealt +2 on the next attack (5 seconds cooldown)
dataList.description: "I saw the Rouges' Brand Director among the raiders. She held an egg against her chest. I could feel it—the faint, godly warmth that spread from within it.  Ah... I think I may understand what she slaughtered us все to accomplish..."

dataList.statText: In the Symbolic, 30% chance to trigger <color=#F8C200>Blossom Scissors-snip Extra Attack</color> dealing 5 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> upon landing an attack (0.3 seconds Hitstun)
dataList.description: Wherever you go, I will snip-snip with these blossom shears until the path beneath you blooms with fallen blossoms.
The Golden Hide is an object of power. Minds may teeter on the brink of descent в a Mannequin, yet the Golden Hide gives them consciousness, guiding them to become a complete Distortion.
A Distortion that has reached the terminus acquires a language only it can understand. It cannot communicate with others with such a language.

dataList.displayName: Golden Hide of the King of Needleworks
dataList.description: Though ages passed, it did not devolve в a Mannequin; вместо этого, aided на the Golden Hide, it remained a sapient Distortion.
Why does the light, bleeding out of the Golden Hide, act as an anchor to the Mannequins' sapience? Should it not вместо этого hasten their descent в mindless Distortions?

dataList.displayName: Golden Hide from the Corpse Pile
dataList.description:
Paradoxically, the golden light wishes for все Distortions to reach their terminus, и при the same time, it не.
What dwells within the light is больше чем a single entity, и neither is the heart inside one of them.

dataList.displayName: Le Rouge Brand Director's Golden Hide
dataList.description:
Distortions can remain sapient и convey their wills to others through various avenues of communication.
That the light не obliterate their wisdom is an irony, и may betray a glimpse of the humanity still dwelling within it.
Through dialogue with the light, customers who carried a piece of the Golden Hide gained powers beyond those of others, which allowed them to expand their influence throughout the Grand Magasin.

dataList.displayName: Golden Hide from the Crack in the Wall
dataList.description:
Le Néant's purpose goes beyond the deconstruction of this department store.
They desire the full, unhindered embrace of the light.

dataList.description: The Sisyphe System is an apparatus built to extract experience from prisoners efficiently и without violence. Within it, prisoners undergo a multitude of experiences, и the variety becomes the base ingredient of Experience Dough. Experience is the perception of change: an unbroken alternation between stillness и motion. Le Noir governs stillness.
